# Boost 1.83.0 declaration closure

This directory contains only the Boost 1.83.0 headers observed in the GCC and
Clang compiler dependency union for the pinned IR MEL `TrackChannel.h`
declaration closure.  It is not a complete Boost distribution and is not a
public `ams_mel_c` dependency.  See `LICENSE_1_0.txt` and
`docs/task-029a-track-boost-closure.md`.
